hospitals.description: Barbara Bush Children's is Maine's children's hospital, run as a hospital within MaineHealth Maine Medical Center on the Portland peninsula. It holds 116 licensed pediatric beds, including an 8-bed PICU, a large NICU and a continuing care nursery, and it takes referrals from every corner of the state and beyond. It runs the state's only dedicated pediatric emergency department, at roughly 13,000 visits a year, and it sits next to Maine's only pediatric cardiovascular surgery team. A 24/7 pediatric and newborn transport team, working with LifeFlight of Maine, brings in critically ill children from the surrounding region. The campus is in Portland's West End, a short drive from the Jetport and from the Old Port, Back Cove and the commuter towns of South Portland, Westbrook and Scarborough.
highlights: Maine's only dedicated pediatric emergency department, about 13,000 visits a year
8-bed PICU caring for 600-plus critically ill children a year
Highest-level NICU in the state (51 beds counting continuing care, per MaineHealth's 2025 anniversary story)
Inside MaineHealth Maine Medical Center, a 929-bed Level I trauma academic center with four Magnet designations
Tufts University School of Medicine Maine Track teaching site
Celebrated 30 years as Barbara Bush Children's in 2025

hospitals.description: Northern Light Mercy is Portland's second hospital, a former Sisters of Mercy institution founded in 1918 that now belongs to Bangor-based Northern Light Health. In 2022 it finished consolidating everything onto its modern Fore River Parkway campus, just across the Fore River from the Jetport, and closed the old State Street building. Its strengths are orthopedics, surgery, cardiovascular care, cancer care and women's health, including a birthing center with private suites. Neonatologists and neonatal nurse practitioners from Maine Neonatology Associates cover the nursery around the clock, and the state lists it as a Level II newborn unit. There is no inpatient pediatric floor, so pediatric work here centers on the nursery and the emergency department.
highlights: Second acute care hospital in the city of Portland
Level II special care nursery with 24/7 neonatologist and NNP coverage
Campus consolidated on Fore River Parkway in 2022
Part of Northern Light Health, Maine's second largest system
Founded in 1918 by the Sisters of Mercy as Queen's Hospital
hospitals.notes: Bed count (230) comes from a third-party directory (datalilyai.com) and is likely the license figure; not confirmed on the hospital site. No inpatient pediatrics, PICU or peds ED. Possible fits for a PNP: nursery/NICU coverage is contracted to Maine Neonatology Associates rather than Mercy employees, so ask whether APP roles exist there. About 1 km from Maine Medical Center, so it is in the same commute zone.

hospitals.description: This is the former Southern Maine Health Care hospital in Biddeford, which became a campus of MaineHealth Maine Medical Center in 2024. It is the inpatient community hospital for Biddeford, Saco, Old Orchard Beach and much of York County, with a 24/7 emergency department, adult hospital medicine and a Family Birth Center. The building sits off Route 111 on the western edge of Biddeford, about 20 miles south of Portland on I-95. Complex pediatric patients transfer up to Barbara Bush Children's in Portland, so pediatric work here centers on the emergency department and newborn care. Its sister Sanford campus no longer has inpatient beds and runs as an emergency department.
highlights: Part of MaineHealth Maine Medical Center since 2024 (formerly Southern Maine Health Care)
24/7 emergency department and Family Birth Center
Inpatient hub for York County after Sanford ended inpatient care in 2015
About 25 minutes south of Portland on I-95

hospitals.description: Mid Coast Hospital is a 93-bed community hospital at Cook's Corner in Brunswick, formed in 1991 when the Bath and Brunswick hospitals merged and moved to a new campus in 2001. It now belongs to MaineHealth and serves Brunswick, Bath, Topsham, Harpswell and the lower Kennebec. It offers a 24/7 emergency department, adult hospital medicine, critical care and obstetrics, and MaineHealth is moving Lincoln Hospital's inpatient labor and delivery here starting in December 2026. Brunswick is a college town (Bowdoin) about 30 minutes up I-295 from Portland, which makes it a realistic commute from the north side of the metro.
highlights: 93 beds, the main hospital for the Brunswick and Bath area
Inpatient labor and delivery from MaineHealth Lincoln Hospital consolidating here from Dec. 18, 2026
24/7 emergency department, expanded in 2009
About 30 minutes from Portland on I-295

hospitals.description: Spring Harbor is MaineHealth's freestanding psychiatric hospital in Westbrook, created in 1999 when Maine Medical Center bought the former Jackson Brook Institute. Of its 100 beds, 40 serve young people: an 8-bed children's unit and three adolescent units with 32 beds, under the Glickman Family Center for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry. It is the main inpatient mental health resource for children and teens in southern Maine and works closely with Barbara Bush Children's. The campus is on a quiet road near the Westbrook and Portland line, about 10 minutes from Maine Medical Center.
highlights: 40 child and adolescent psychiatric beds (8 child, 32 adolescent)
Glickman Family Center for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, founded 2007
Part of MaineHealth Behavioral Health
10 minutes from the Portland peninsula
hospitals.notes: Psychiatric specialty hospital; peds_inpatient is false because these are psychiatric units, not a general pediatric floor. Included because the brief asked for Spring Harbor as a Portland-area pediatric specialty site. An acute care PNP would most likely fit a medical consult or psych-NP-adjacent role here, so relevance is lower than the acute hospitals.
